scope: Editorial comparison of the general theorems and consistent endpoint notation; not a new independent mathematical audit.
changes: Reproduced the v1 general theorem as an unnumbered historical statement immediately before the current general theorem, with both statements together on page 2.
Used C_B^(1)m-1 and C_Bm-1 for the two endpoints and displayed their respective totient sums and explicit ceiling formulas.
Added the multipliers for B=1,2,3 and explained the odd grids and change in pole spacing from 4 to 2.
Introduced a_B=C_B-1 explicitly in Section 8 and updated the paper guide.
Removed the superseded short version-change paragraph near the end of the introduction.

validation.v1_restatement: The same quantifiers, count and interval as v1, with C_B^(1)=s_B+1 and the original totient sum and ceiling formula.
validation.comparison_calculation: Computed the six displayed multipliers with 80-digit Decimal logarithms; the source formulas were separately matched to v1 and the preceding v2.
validation.endpoint_section_change: Introduces a_B=C_B-1 explicitly; the pole order, estimates and endpoint are unchanged.

visual_review.method: All 20 pages were rendered and visually inspected after the historical and current general theorems were kept together on page 2.
visual_review.result: No clipped text, broken formulas, table collisions or page-layout defects found.

publication_status: Local revision; no commit, push or Hexagon submission made for this revision.
